call_points.text: Passed on ~80% of raw material cost inflation across categories through cumulative price hikes.
Cumulative price hikes in fans reached 17–18% over the past nine months to mitigate input inflation.
Evaluation of greenfield manufacturing plant for fans, appliances, and wires is in advanced stages.
Identified the domestic solar rooftop addressable market size at ₹26,000 Cr.
LKA business restructuring under Butterfly leadership aims to reverse its ₹16-25 Cr EBITDA loss.
No numeric revenue or margin guidance; A&P spend as a percentage of sales should be similar to last year.
No further sharp price increases seen as necessary; pricing, cost measures and operating leverage should support margins.
Plans a greenfield plant with large warehousing over the next two-three years, spending about ₹350 Cr.
Solar rooftop order book is about ₹500 Cr, of which ₹450 Cr is to be executed over 6-8 months.
Solar rooftop revenue is recognised on installation; execution is expected mostly in Q2.
BLDC fans grew ~45% this quarter; five new BLDC fans were launched.
Pricing interventions of high-single to low-double digits covered about 80% of inflationary pressures.
Low-cost inventory did not materially help margins; the company runs a lean inventory model.
Supply disruptions cost about ₹200 Cr of primary sales, largely in fans/ECD; the seasonal sales will not be recovered.
Competitors have largely not followed price hikes, which management attributes to their low-cost inventory.
Solar businesses do not run on negative working capital, but management says ROCE is good; government payments are on time.
Brand refresh visible from end-August, with a brand launch on 18 August and a capital market investor event on 20 August.
EBIT margins improved from 6.8% in H1 to exit at about 10% in Q4.
BLDC fans portfolio is growing at over 30% supported by new product introductions.
Solar rooftop order book reached approximately ₹500 Cr with over 5,000 homes already executed.
Butterfly business delivered 17% revenue growth with steady EBIT margins and robust cash flows.
Cumulative price increases of 7% to 8% were taken in lead categories like fans to offset raw material inflation.
A new super-premium product line named 'Crompton Rhion' was announced, folding in the Large Kitchen Appliance business.
Butterfly is now cash flow positive with about ₹170 Cr of cash.
